blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte’s camp will ask the Supreme Court (SC) to reconsider its dismissal of his children’s petitions for a writ of habeas corpus challenging his arrest and transfer to the International Criminal Court (ICC). In a statement on Wednesday, lawyer Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr., counsel for Duterte’s daughter Veronica, said they were disappointed with the High Court’s decision and would file a motion for reconsideration. “Yesterday we received, with deep disappointment, the Supreme Court’s ruling dismissing the petitions for habeas corpus as moot, and declining to pass upon the legality of former President Rodrigo Duterte’s rendition […]...
